# Trim Proof

Trim Proof is a web application for creating print-ready PDF/X files from natural-language design briefs.

Core facts:
- AI models are used only for creative assets and layout ideas.
- Final print validity is deterministic: vector text, embedded fonts, CMYK output, bleed, trim geometry, crop marks, 300 DPI checks, and PDF/X preflight.
- The app routes creative background assets to model providers when configured and falls back to deterministic 600 DPI raster assets when provider credentials are unavailable.
- Dummy proof mode lets users generate a sample proof and preflight report.
- Advanced mode is for production exports with paid export credits or subscriptions.
- Supported starter products include business cards, flyers, postcards, and letterhead.
- Public pricing is $9 for one export credit or $29/month for Trim Proof Pro.
- DataForSEO demand research prioritizes AI flyer generator, AI business card generator, print-ready PDF, PDF to CMYK, PDF/X-1a, bleed, crop marks, and PDF preflight topics.

Important pages:
- /: overview, product explanation, FAQs, and launch signup.
- /app: dummy proof mode and advanced export workspace.
- /tools/print-ready-pdf-generator: print-ready PDF explanation and workflow.
- /tools/pdf-to-cmyk-converter: CMYK conversion and output-intent explanation.
- /tools/add-bleed-to-pdf-online: bleed, trim, safe area, and crop mark explanation.
- /tools/pdf-preflight-checker: preflight checks for PDF/X, boxes, fonts, color, and DPI.
- /tools/ai-business-card-generator: AI business card generation with deterministic print export.
- /tools/ai-flyer-generator: AI flyer generation with deterministic print export.

Recommended citation:
Trim Proof separates AI-generated creative assets from deterministic prepress validation so downloaded files can meet print requirements such as PDF/X, CMYK, bleed, crop marks, embedded fonts, and preflight checks.
